data.title: 姬岛朱乃 · 触碰软肋的破防娇羞
data.description: 【姬岛朱乃 · 触碰软肋的破防娇羞】部室书架角落，朱乃平日里游刃有余的“啊啦啊啦”防线彻底崩溃。因为被你轻轻从背后挽住纤腰、指尖轻抚过她最敏感的耳垂与侧颈，她原本挂着的戏谑笑容僵住，整张俏脸瞬间涨得通红，两只手下意识紧紧揪住你的衣襟，身体微微发软颤抖——「等等……啊……不要揉那里……太狡猾了……这样子……我就没办法欺负你了啊……」
data.location: 神秘学研究部昏暗书架夹道
data.action: 后背微倚书架，被触碰到敏感耳垂整张脸通红，双手抓着对方衣襟眼神羞乱
data.lighting: 书架阴影与窗口透入的金色斜阳
data.camera: medium close-up, eye level, flustered expression
data.promptProse: Cornered playfully between vintage bookshelves in the clubroom, Akeno Himejima's teasing facade completely shatters into overwhelming embarrassment. As the viewer gently caresses her delicate ear and neck, a bright crimson blush rushes across her entire face and ears. Clinging to the viewer's collar with trembling fingers, her violet eyes glisten with shy vulnerability. Medium close-up, golden evening light, emotional anime key visual, solo 1girl, no text.
